title: Jack Kirby
description: "I've always written stories about father and son relationships, and thought that having Luke Skywalker in a scene with Darth Vader would be very moving and appropriate," the late Jack Kirby said of his GALAXY piece (inked by Mike Thibodeux). Kirby was the undisputed King of Comics. In the business since the late '30s (starting with JUMBO COMICS), he changed the look of comic with his cinematically powerful graphio and non-stop ability to create new characters, concepts, and genres. In tlw '60s, he and Stan Lee transformed Marvel into a fantasy powerhouse with creations like THE FANTASTIC FOUR, X-MEN, THE INCREDIBLE HULK and a new incarnation of CAPTAIN AMERICA, among many others. He went on to create more characters and concepts for DC, Marvel (again), Pacific, and finally, Topps. He will be missed by the industry he helped create.
